summary.text: Becky Drury is a Republican candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives, District 34, and a former state representative who served from 2021 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Drury earned a master's degree in human resources management/personnel administration from the University of South Dakota in 2009.
Her career experience includes working as a communications specialist and marketing coordinator with Golden West Telecommunications.
Drury was elected to the South Dakota House of Representatives from District 32 in 2020 and won re-election in 2022.
In the 2023–2024 session she chaired the House Local Government Committee and also served on the Military and Veterans' Affairs and State Affairs committees.
She finished third in the June 2024 Republican primary for District 34 and left office in January 2025.
In the June 2, 2026 Republican primary she was one of two candidates advancing in District 34, receiving 29.1 percent of the vote.
